items.title: Bitcoin bottoms on 4-year anniversary of FTX low: Nvidia rips 30%
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses Bitcoin sweeping its lows to about $55,200 on the exact date of its November 2022 FTX-era bottom before bouncing more than 15%, Nvidia surging 30% premarket on Jensen Huang's return as CEO, and what the VIX's fifth-largest weekly spike on record has historically meant for stocks.
